subject: Pilot demo scheduling — Atlas Health (year-end blackout workaround)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed shift for Q4 pilot demo with Atlas Health

Quick note — Atlas asked to avoid live sessions during Dec 26–30 (their office holiday window) and they’re also sending people to re:Invent the week after. We have the scheduled pilot demo on Jan 6 in their original plan, but procurement flagged a calendar blackout for budget approval the week of Dec 27.

Options I see:
- Move the live demo earlier (Dec 23) — risk: some of our SEs are out for holiday travel.
- Keep Jan 6 but record a brief pre-demo video + make live Q&A optional the first week of Jan.
- Offer an internal technical deep-dive the week of Jan 4 and the exec overview on Jan 6.

If we go for Jan 6 live, we should have a fallback recording and a named POC for procurement questions. Can we confirm SE availability? I think Rohan can cover the deep-dive if needed.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot demo scheduling — Atlas Health (year-end blackout workaround)

Hi Emily — thanks for flagging the holiday blackout. We want to make this easy for your team and keep momentum on the pilot. Three quick options that would work on our side: 

1) A shorter live session on Thursday, Dec 23 (30–45 minutes) — quick exec overview + product tour.
2) Full live pilot the week of Jan 4; we can do Jan 5 or Jan 6 for the hands-on run.
3) If you need to keep the week after the holidays clear, we can record a 12–15 minute walk-through now and schedule a live 30-minute Q&A on Jan 6 (recommended if some stakeholders are remote).

Attached is an updated mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_v3.pdf) that reflects the revised dates and the procurement touchpoints. For calendars: Jan 5/6 availability from our side is wide open but I want to confirm the time zone that suits your product and procurement teams.

Can you tell me which of these three is easiest for you and which participants you want at the session (product, engineering, procurement)? Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and block Rohan for a technical deep-dive as needed.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Barnes <emily@atlashealth.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@atlashealth.io>, procurement@atlashealth.io
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot demo scheduling — Atlas Health (year-end blackout workaround)

Thanks, Grace — appreciate the options.

Dec 23 won’t work for us — too many folks wrapping up. Our product and engineering teams are available Jan 5–7; procurement is effectively offline Dec 26–30 and will be slow the first few business days back. The best single slot for cross-team attendance would be Jan 6 at 10:00 AM PST. Can you do that?

If Jan 6 is impossible for your SEs, we’d take the recorded walkthrough + 30-minute live Q&A on Jan 6 (same time) so the procurement team can watch the recording beforehand. Also, please include a short one-pager on data retention and network isolation for our security lead to review ahead of time (we’ll need that for internal sign-off).

Emily Barnes
Director of Product | Atlas Health
emily@atlashealth.io

- Ben: confirm final attendee list from Atlas

Monica
